collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART IX (161-180, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A child announces they are old enough to fetch the water alone with the big jar: let them go, or offer the small one.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has announced that (subject.he/she) is old enough to fetch the water by (subject.him/her)self. Alone. With the big jar. (friend) looks at the jar, which is nearly as big as (subject), and then at (subject)'s very determined face.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "How about the small jar first?" suggests (friend). (subject) thinks about arguing, then takes the small jar and marches off. (subject.He/She) brings it back completely full, without spilling a drop, and sets it down with a thump. "Tomorrow," (subject.he/she) says, "the big one." (friend) doesn't doubt it.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (subject) sets off with the jar, walking very straight and very proud. (friend) watches from the doorway until (subject.he/she) is out of sight, then, very casually, wanders down the path after (subject.him/her). (subject) comes back with the jar about half full and (subject.his/her) front completely soaked. "I did it," (subject.he/she) says. "I did it ALL BY MYSELF." (friend) agrees that (subject.he/she) absolutely did.
